mill has been broken for twenty years
expected.note: Whether the Skerry Head mill works: abandoned in chapter 1, standing and grinding in chapter 2, broken for twenty years later, and a roofless shell since 1931 in chapter 7.

note: Chapters drafted by a local model from a written outline. The draft already contradicted itself about the mill; the 1890 and 1931 sentences were planted by hand to sharpen that thread.
